searchText: How does Ethereum check if two identical validators are voting for a block? network participants can run a slasher https://docs.prylabs.network/docs/prysm-usage/slasher which collects all attestations and checks if they are slashable thx so it's means no official mechanism to check double voting? what's slashable is well defined and there are incentives to slash misbehaving validators, i think that's as official as it gets, ethereum has no reference implementation if you mean checking from a validator point of view thats pretty simple: don't vote more than once per validator per epoch - EVER i know from teku that it will simply write the highest epoch it ever attested to into a file and will only vote again for a later epoch (you can also get slashed for trying to alter history but afaik this would need to be fabricated and an honest validator could never do this by accident) the other slasher implementation is Lighthouse: <https://lighthouse-book.sigmaprime.io/slasher.html>
